native.browser: Edge, SwiftShader, Vite, real CDP input/Worker
native.parallelFloorTasksNote: Concurrent floorTasks run exceeded the 18 s preview wait and is excluded; a solo rerun passed 18/18 without counting toward the claim.

independent.method: pypdf + Poppler render + Pillow, independent of the WebCAD renderer

portable.undoRedoAndReopen: Import Undo/Redo, wall 200->250 mm edit with explicit drawing rebind, single Undo/Redo, v42 save/reopen with new Undo session

limitations: Self-authored 6000 x 4000 mm validation task, not a measured customer drawing or code-compliant design
No automatic corner fusing; walls use independent butt ends
Window is an open frame without glass product detail; door swing, exact clearance and code checks excluded
Negative fixtures were diagnosed in Node regression, not all repeated through the real UI
Circular hole is geometry/print validation intent, not life-safety design
CAN/MEAS/IO extensions and G6-D5-Q1 pre-issue review remain separate cards
scope: WF-Q1 first supported small-residential prepare->walls/openings->slot fenestration/furniture->plan/section/A3 issue, edit/reissue/reopen range
